title:
Epic that handles plotting the selected {@link Feature} in the Model Scenario Details Chart.
### Expected Payload:
- {@link UiSdlRowCellClickPayload} containing the selected data item from the Features Grid.
The epic will update the {@link ModelScenarioDetailsApplicationState#dataMap} with the
`selectedFeatureId` key, and then trigger the {@link ModelScenarioDetailsApplicationState#getChartDataAction}.
name: ModelScenarioDetailsPlotFeatureEpic
